hook: Borrow gold now, let the interest feed your ravens, and make the losers pay your debts.
loop: Write IOUs on your Ledger by borrowing gold or playing magpies.
Every gold of interest or pay-off fires your ravens' Collect.
Hold debt to power Eldest, or clear it for Grandmother Corbie.

growth.line: Each gold paid onto the Ledger is +1/+1 somewhere; capstones turn a full Ledger into whole-tribe buffs.

feel.early: Strong bodies on credit; borrow to tier up fast.
feel.mid: Warden and Thought grow the tab; pawn and replay.
feel.late: Hold or clear: Seven and Eldest versus Grandmother Corbie.

stars.why: Pawn a unit for gold, replay its When-played when paid.
Other tribes' units pay your debt and get Shield.
Capstone that pays you to clear debt, against Eldest's hold.

card_short.u01: Solid early body; When played: write an IOU 2.
card_short.u02: Collect: grows +1/+1, twice a turn and twice a fight.
card_short.u03: After a win, if alive: Skim. Debt-free: 1 gold.
card_short.u04: Extra gold you gain becomes +1/+1 on another unit.
card_short.u05: When played: give a unit +4/+4, write an IOU 2.
card_short.u06: Start of Turn: Borrow 2 while under 3 IOUs.
card_short.u07: Feathers enemies that kill yours; feathered deaths pay your debt.
card_short.u08: After a loss, shop offers the enemy's biggest unit cheap.
card_short.u09: On each IOU clear, buffs neighbours; more beside Sorrow.
card_short.u10: Pawn a sold unit: Borrow 3; it returns when cleared.
card_short.u11: Each Collect passes a +1/+1 bowl along the zigzag.
card_short.u12: Two non-Syndicate units pay your debt and get Shield.
card_short.u13: When played: becomes a copy of another friendly unit.
card_short.u14: Collect and IOU-clear effects trigger twice.
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: steals Attack and keywords from three enemies.
card_short.u16: Start of Combat: Syndicate +1/+1 per open IOU.
card_short.u17: Each IOU clear: Syndicate permanently gain up to +5/+5.
card_short.u18: Hidden from scouts; pays your interest free; grows on Collect.
card_short.u19: End of Turn: unspent gold, up to 6, buffs Syndicate.

builds.name: Running a tab
builds.line: Hold many IOUs; Collect the interest; Memory, Seven and Eldest pay out.

builds.name: The pawnshop
builds.line: Pawn When-played units with Uncle Jack, clear the IOU, replay them.

builds.name: The family business
builds.line: Another tribe's carry pays your debt under the Enforcer and gets Shield.

liked: All three: hold-or-clear debt is a real new choice every turn.
Uncle Jack's pawnshop, cash a unit and replay it, was every reviewer's standout.
worries: Watch: Memory, Seven and Grandmother Corbie stacking Collects could run away late.
Watch: Uncle Jack with Bagman pays out every win; Sorrow, Mirror skip tiers.
changed: Skim now counts as the loser paying, so every win feeds Collect.
Memorys no longer stack; Uncle Jack can't pawn on a full Ledger.
Clearer wording for Clerk, Warden, Jackdaw and Grandmother Corbie's full amount.
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct; ranked second of its three, with the most memorable cards; for players who like juggling debt.
